children: Copper is higher in early Asian trading as some investors buy the dip. The metal has faced downward pressure in recent weeks amid a fading AI trade. Copper is seen as a key metal in data center development. Overnight, U.S. tech stocks had another tough session, following a brief rally on Monday driven by the return of Nvidia's chief executive. Volatility in the tech sector and shifting U.S. Fed policy expectations are the primary near-term headwinds, say Nanhua Futures analysts in a research note. The three-month LME copper contract is 1.1% higher at $11,956.00 a ton. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
